info.name: Ayesha - Orders Payments Coupons Reports
info.description: Make Me Pretty API requests grouped into Setup, Orders/COD, SSLCommerz Payments, Coupons, Reports, Share Your Experience, and Contact messages. Optional delivery, other-customer ownership, ineligible review, and real SSLCommerz callback checks skip when prerequisites are missing.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const page = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('Product listing has the documented response shape', () => pm.expect(page.data).to.be.an('array')); const product = page.data?.find((item) => Number(item.stock) > 0); if (product && !pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')) pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', product._id); }
console.warn('Optional delivery account could not log in; delivery-only requests will be skipped.');
pm.test('Delivery login is optional when no valid delivery account is configured', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401));

item.name: Create COD order (server amount; starts pending)

request.description: Needs a valid productId with stock. The request includes forged totals/discounts; the server must ignore them.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId',d._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderNumber',d.orderNumber); pm.test('Fulfillment and payment statuses are distinct',()=>{pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('pending');pm.expect(d.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending');}); pm.test('Server calculates nonnegative totals',()=>{pm.expect(d.subtotal).to.be.a('number');pm.expect(d.total).to.be.a('number');pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(d.subtotal+d.deliveryCharge-d.discount);}); }

if(pm.response.code===201){const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.test('Client payment status/currency/transaction fields are ignored',()=>{pm.expect(d.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending');pm.expect(d.paymentMethod).to.eql('cod');});}

pm.test('Replay returns existing order successfully',()=>pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code)); if ([200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { pm.test('No second order is created',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId'))); pm.test('Payment remains pending',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending')); }

item.name: Reuse COD key with changed order data
Customer cannot read order without authentication
Get owned order and verify COD payment status

exec: pm.test('Customer can read own order',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if(pm.response.code===200){pm.test('COD is still pending before collection',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending'));}

item.name: Payment status cannot be set as fulfillment status (admin)

exec: pm.test('Payment status is not accepted as order status',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: Assign COD order to delivery partner (admin)

request.description: Requires adminToken and deliveryPartnerId.

exec: pm.test('Order assignment succeeds',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('Assignment confirms fulfillment only; COD remains pending',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('confirmed');pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending');});

item.name: Advance assigned order to shipped (delivery partner)

exec: pm.test('Partner can advance assigned fulfillment status',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('Shipping does not mark COD paid',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending'));

item.name: Advance assigned order to out for delivery

exec: pm.test('Assigned order reaches outForDelivery',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('COD remains unpaid before collection',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending'));

pm.test('Authorized partner can confirm collected COD',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('Both statuses reflect payment collection',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('paid');pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('outForDelivery');});

pm.test('Repeated collection is idempotent',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('Order stays paid',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('paid'));

item.name: Public order tracking now requires login (401)

exec: pm.test('Tracking without a login is rejected (401)',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: Create separate COD order for cancellation

request.description: Creates a second test order so the COD delivery and collection flow can remain intact. Cancellation restores the reserved stock.

exec: pm.test('Cancellation test order is created unpaid',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201));if(pm.response.code===201){const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.collectionVariables.set('cancelOrderId',d._id);pm.test('Cancellation starts from pending states',()=>{pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('pending');pm.expect(d.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending');});}

item.name: Unassigned delivery partner cannot collect COD

request.description: Run after creating the separate cancellation test order and before cancelling it. A logged-in but unassigned delivery partner must not confirm collection.

exec: pm.test('Unassigned delivery partner cannot confirm COD collection',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(404));

request.description: Uses the existing admin order-status route. Requires adminToken. The unpaid COD payment must transition to cancelled along with order fulfillment status.

exec: pm.test('Admin can cancel the unpaid COD order',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));if(pm.response.code===200){const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.test('Order and payment move to their separate cancelled states',()=>{pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('cancelled');pm.expect(d.paymentStatus).to.eql('cancelled');});}

item.name: Customer cannot read another customer order

request.description: Set otherCustomerOrderId to an order owned by a different customer. Requires the first customerToken.

exec: pm.test('Order ownership prevents another customer from reading order/payment status',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Config endpoint reports sandbox state without secrets',()=>{pm.response.to.have.status(200);const body=pm.response.json();const d=body.data;pm.expect(d.environment).to.eql('sandbox');pm.expect(d.sslCommerzEnabled).to.be.a('boolean');pm.expect(JSON.stringify(body).toLowerCase()).not.to.match(/store_password|store_id/);pm.collectionVariables.set('sslCommerzEnabled',String(d.sslCommerzEnabled));});

request.description: Requires a valid customer and product. SSLCommerz sandbox order total must be between ৳10 and ৳500,000.

exec: pm.test('SSLCommerz order is created pending',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201)); if(pm.response.code===201){const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.collectionVariables.set('sslOrderId',d._id);pm.test('Order payment starts pending',()=>pm.expect(d.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending'));}

request.description: When configured, returns a hosted redirect URL. When not configured, expects 503 and does not mark the order paid.

exec: if(pm.collectionVariables.get('sslCommerzEnabled')==='true'){pm.test('Session is initialized',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201));if(pm.response.code===201){const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.collectionVariables.set('sslTransactionId',d.transactionId);pm.test('Redirect points to sandbox hosted checkout',()=>pm.expect(d.redirectUrl).to.match(/^https:\/\/sandbox\.sslcommerz\.com\//));pm.test('Attempt returns unique identifiers',()=>{pm.expect(d.paymentId).to.be.a('string');pm.expect(d.transactionId).to.be.a('string');});}}else{pm.test('Unconfigured sandbox refuses initiation safely',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(503));}

item.name: Repeat SSLCommerz initiation with same idempotency key

exec: if(pm.collectionVariables.get('sslCommerzEnabled')==='true'){pm.test('Same attempt is reused',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(201));if(pm.response.code===201)pm.test('Transaction id is unchanged',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.transactionId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('sslTransactionId')));}else pm.test('Sandbox remains safely unavailable',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(503));

item.name: Success browser callback verifies completed sandbox transaction

request.description: Run after completing the hosted sandbox checkout. This endpoint queries SSLCommerz by tran_id; posted status is intentionally omitted.

exec: pm.test('Verified success callback returns to the payment result page',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(303));

const callbackLocation=new URL(pm.response.headers.get('Location')||'http://localhost');const result=callbackLocation.searchParams.get('result');const callbackOrderId=callbackLocation.searchParams.get('orderId');pm.test('Redirect reports only server-verified success or pending review',()=>pm.expect(['success','pending']).to.include(result));if(callbackOrderId)pm.collectionVariables.set('sslOrderId',callbackOrderId);

item.name: Failure callback for real sandbox failed transaction (manual)

request.description: Optional. Only run with an existing payment attempt whose actual SSLCommerz transaction failed. Set sslFailedTransactionId from that attempt. Backend queries the gateway; the submitted status is not trusted.

exec: pm.test('Verified failed callback redirects to the payment result page',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(303));

const callbackLocation=new URL(pm.response.headers.get('Location')||'http://localhost');const callbackOrderId=callbackLocation.searchParams.get('orderId');pm.test('Redirect result is failure',()=>pm.expect(callbackLocation.searchParams.get('result')).to.eql('failure'));if(callbackOrderId){pm.collectionVariables.set('sslFailedOrderId',callbackOrderId);pm.sendRequest({url:pm.variables.get('baseUrl')+'/api/orders/'+callbackOrderId,method:'GET',header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.collectionVariables.get('customerToken')}},(error,response)=>{pm.test('failed callback order status can be checked by its owner',()=>{pm.expect(error).to.eql(null);pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(200);});if(!error&&response.code===200)pm.test('Server verified failed payment status',()=>pm.expect(response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('failed'));});}else pm.test('Callback includes an order reference for status lookup',()=>pm.expect(callbackOrderId).to.be.a('string'));
console.warn('Manual SSLCommerz test skipped: sandbox is disabled or transaction ID is empty.');

item.name: Cancellation callback for real sandbox cancelled transaction (manual)

request.description: Optional. Only run with an existing payment attempt actually cancelled on SSLCommerz. Set sslCancelledTransactionId from that attempt. Backend queries the gateway; the submitted status is not trusted.

exec: pm.test('Verified cancelled callback redirects to the payment result page',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(303));

const callbackLocation=new URL(pm.response.headers.get('Location')||'http://localhost');const callbackOrderId=callbackLocation.searchParams.get('orderId');pm.test('Redirect result is cancelled',()=>pm.expect(callbackLocation.searchParams.get('result')).to.eql('cancelled'));if(callbackOrderId){pm.collectionVariables.set('sslCancelledOrderId',callbackOrderId);pm.sendRequest({url:pm.variables.get('baseUrl')+'/api/orders/'+callbackOrderId,method:'GET',header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.collectionVariables.get('customerToken')}},(error,response)=>{pm.test('cancelled callback order status can be checked by its owner',()=>{pm.expect(error).to.eql(null);pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(200);});if(!error&&response.code===200)pm.test('Server verified cancelled payment status',()=>pm.expect(response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('cancelled'));});}else pm.test('Callback includes an order reference for status lookup',()=>pm.expect(callbackOrderId).to.be.a('string'));
console.warn('Manual SSLCommerz test skipped: sandbox is disabled or transaction ID is empty.');

item.name: Verify completed sandbox payment via IPN (manual)

request.description: Only run after completing the hosted sandbox checkout. Set sslTransactionId to the transactionId returned by initiation. The app queries SSLCommerz by tran_id; the submitted status field is intentionally omitted.

exec: pm.test('SSLCommerz validates the transaction server-side',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));pm.test('IPN acknowledges verified callback',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('OK'));
console.warn('Manual SSLCommerz test skipped: sandbox is disabled or transaction ID is empty.');

item.name: Invalid SSLCommerz validation reference does not pay order

request.description: Run only after Create SSLCommerz order and Initiate hosted SSLCommerz payment, before paying at the hosted checkout. Sends a fake validation reference and a forged callback status. The backend must ask SSLCommerz to validate it; this is a real provider request, not a mock. It does not simulate a provider amount/currency mismatch.

exec: pm.sendRequest({url:pm.variables.get('baseUrl')+'/api/orders/'+pm.collectionVariables.get('sslOrderId'),method:'GET',header:{Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.collectionVariables.get('customerToken')}},(error,response)=>{pm.test('Order status is readable after invalid callback',()=>{pm.expect(error).to.eql(null);pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(200);});if(!error&&response.code===200)pm.test('Forged callback status did not mark the payment paid',()=>pm.expect(response.json().data.paymentStatus).to.eql('pending'));});

item.name: Update test coupon to fixed discount
Update test coupon to shipping discount

exec: if(pm.response.code===200){const d=pm.response.json().data;const s=d.summary;pm.test('Report includes backend summary and sections',()=>{pm.expect(s).to.be.an('object');pm.expect(d.salesByDate).to.be.an('array');pm.expect(d.salesByMonth).to.be.an('array');pm.expect(d.statusBreakdown).to.be.an('object');pm.expect(d.bestSellingProducts).to.be.an('array');pm.expect(d.paymentMethods).to.be.an('array');pm.expect(d.receivedOrders).to.be.an('array');});const round=n=>Math.round(n*100)/100;const dayTotal=round(d.salesByDate.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.revenue,0));const monthTotal=round(d.salesByMonth.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.revenue,0));pm.test('Daily and monthly received revenue totals match summary',()=>{pm.expect(dayTotal).to.eql(round(s.receivedRevenue));pm.expect(monthTotal).to.eql(round(s.receivedRevenue));});pm.test('Monthly received-order counts match summary',()=>pm.expect(d.salesByMonth.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.orders,0)).to.eql(s.receivedOrderCount));pm.test('Dates and months use consistent YYYY-MM keys',()=>{d.salesByDate.forEach(item=>pm.expect(item.date).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/));d.salesByMonth.forEach(item=>pm.expect(item.month).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/));});pm.test('Received order rows include backend month key and no demo flag',()=>d.receivedOrders.forEach(item=>{pm.expect(item.month).to.eql(item.date.slice(0,7));pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('isDemo');}));}

if(pm.response.code===200)pm.test('Product report is an array of backend totals',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('array');pm.response.json().data.forEach(item=>{pm.expect(item.unitsSold).to.be.a('number');pm.expect(item.revenue).to.be.a('number');});});

if(pm.response.code===200)pm.test('Response contains only approved reviews and a rating summary',()=>{const d=pm.response.json().data;pm.expect(d.reviews).to.be.an('array');pm.expect(d.reviews.every(review=>review.status==='approved')).to.eql(true);pm.expect(d.rating).to.be.an('object');});

request.description: Creates a pending review tied to the signed-in customer. The API permits one review per customer per product; choose another productId if a duplicate already exists.

exec: pm.test('Review is correctly blocked when customer has no delivered order for this product', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('Review is created or correctly rejected as an existing duplicate', () => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('New review starts pending and is server-linked to customer', () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(d.customer).to.exist; });

item.name: Reject duplicate review for same customer and product

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get('reviewSubmissionIneligible') === 'true') { console.warn('Duplicate-review request skipped because the customer is not eligible for this product review.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

item.name: Admin review list rejects unauthenticated request
Customer cannot access admin review list

exec: pm.test('Customer is forbidden from admin review list',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(403));

if(pm.response.code===200){const data=pm.response.json().data;pm.test('Admin review response is an array',()=>pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'));const id=pm.collectionVariables.get('reviewTestId');if(id)pm.test('New pending review appears in the admin list',()=>pm.expect(data.some(review=>review._id===id)).to.eql(true));}

request.description: Creates a real MongoDB contact message. It will remain in the admin inbox; the status update request below marks it resolved.

exec: pm.test('Invalid contact message is rejected with 400',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: Contact honeypot is quietly accepted without creating a message

exec: pm.test('Honeypot is quietly accepted without creating a stored message', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));
if (pm.response.code === 202) pm.test('Response does not expose whether message was stored', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.accepted).to.eql(true));

item.name: Admin Contact inbox rejects unauthenticated request
Customer cannot access Admin Contact inbox
Admin lists Contact messages and finds saved test message

exec: if(pm.response.code===200){const data=pm.response.json().data;pm.test('Inbox contains a message array',()=>pm.expect(data).to.be.an('array'));const id=pm.collectionVariables.get('contactMessageTestId');if(id)pm.test('Newly submitted message appears in the database-backed inbox',()=>pm.expect(data.some(message=>message._id===id)).to.eql(true));}

item.name: Unauthenticated user cannot update Contact message

exec: pm.test('Customer is forbidden from updating Contact status',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(403));
